actions.rationale: Pay Sep-2027 SOFR futures: post-hike overnight at 3.85% leaves the SR3U7 terminal underpriced relative to still-hot US policy gauges.

events.invalidation: Lock of SOFR_2027-09 implied rate back through the packet 6m SR3H7 forward context (~4.58) or concurrent US labor/inflation gauge cooldown that validates the priced 2028 easing fade; a 100th-percentile US 2Y print alone is not exit.
events.rationale: Empty book with full $1bn unused cash earns official NY Fed SOFR 3.85% ACT/360 (2026-09-17); SR3 4.32/4.58/4.755 is forward context only and shows the market still embedding additional US tightening versus that cash hurdle. rate-hawk and trend-follower handoffs align on SOFR_2027-09 as the clean rates-first expression after the hike; no-trade-skeptic and cross-seat AONIA/NZD conflicts argue for selectivity, not diffusion. Deploying ~90% gross into a single SR3U7 pay accepts mark-to-market risk versus ~385bp annualized cash, but path repricing toward a higher terminal over a 1–6 month horizon is the only clustered edge that clears the post-hike funding reset without options, without NZ-rate gaps, and without opposing Canada/Australia STIR bets.
events.thesis: After the delivered Sep-16 Fed hike, realized SOFR reset to 3.85% while the exact 12m SR3U7 terminal still prices only modest further tightening before a 2028 fade; US inflation, labor, activity, and consumer gauges remain hot, so the residual path—not the already-priced first cut of the cycle—is the mispriced object. Concentrate in pay SOFR_2027-09 rather than split across conflicting AU AONIA, NZ FX, or CA bond/STIR expressions.
